messages:
alex: Thinking of trying a low-key 'paw-luck' in the courtyard next Friday — people bring snacks for themselves and a little treat for dogs if they want. BYO blanket, dogs on leash. :dog: :paw_prints:
maya: Love this idea! Which Friday? Next one or the week after? :yum:
chris: Next Friday works for me. Can we label vegan/peanut-free stuff? want to avoid any dog allergy scares.
sam: Ooh puppuccinos? There's a cafe nearby that makes dog-safe foam toppers. I can pick them up if folks chip in. :coffee: :dog:
tereza: I can bring collapsible water bowls, some chew-safe toys, and do a small cookie-decor station (human & dog-safe icing).
alex: Awesome — thanks tereza. Quick poll: noon or 3pm? Noon seems better for folks walking dogs during lunch.
maya: noon for sure. easier for people to step out. :raised_hands:
chris: noon +1 (and i'll bring savory pastries).
dev-calendar-bot: Event created: "Paw-luck & Puppuccino — Courtyard" — Fri Jun 7 12:00–13:30 — RSVP: https://calendar.redwood.example/e/abc123
```
Invite: Paw-luck & Puppuccino
When: Fri Jun 7, 12:00–13:30
Where: Courtyard (outside building B entrance)
Notes: Dogs on leash, please clean up after pets. Label food for allergies.
```
sam: I'll handle puppuccino pickup. Who wants extras for their pup? (reaction: :thumbsup:)
tereza: I'll make peanut-free icing and label everything. Also bringing puppy-safe carrots and training treats.
alex: Can someone bring a spare towel or two for muddy paws? Also reminder: building policy requires leashes & updated vax records if the dogters need to be on-site.
maya: I'll bring a towel and put a note on the door so delivery folks know about the pet gathering.
chris: tagging Facilities to confirm courtyard permission? @facilities anyone?
sam: Also bringing small cat-safe treats in case anyone brings a cat (low key). :cat:
alex: Perfect. I'll post a simple sign-up sheet in this channel with slots for food and supplies. If anyone wants to add a quick demo (puppy tricks?), put it in the sign-up comment.
maya: Luna will do a 30-second sit/stay demo. :grin:
tereza: Seriously can't wait. This will be cute and chill.
alex: Thanks all — i'll follow up with the sign-up link and a reminder 2 days before. (reaction: :party_popper:)
